sn26.10:1.2: yo bhikkhave, rūpassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn26.10:1.6: yo viññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn26.10:1.7: yo ca kho bhikkhave, rūpassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo.
sn26.10:1.11: yo viññāṇassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamoti.
